findings.quote: Like any new technology, AI poses risks and brings challenges. But with knowledge, wisdom and unity, we can put it to use in the service of humanity.
findings.rationale: Argues for harnessing AI for humanity while acknowledging risks and challenges.

findings.quote: As a co-chair of the first UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance, alongside with El Salvador, Estonia has proudly brought its knowledge and experience in service of the UN and its member states.
findings.rationale: Describes UN AI governance and AI for Good participation, reliable inclusive AI, national educational AI innovation, UNICEF cooperation and international benefit sharing.
